subject: Reframe: Demo timing request after stakeholder surge (security + procurement)
messages:
From: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@treadstonehealth.com>
To: chloe_martin@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Ben Chu <ben.chu@treadstonehealth.com>
Date: 2028-04-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Demo — additional stakeholders and timing constraints

Hi Chloe / Marissa,

Thanks again for setting up the demo next week. We've had a last-minute change on our side: our CISO and two procurement leads need to join the session. That expands the audience to include security, platform, infra and procurement — they typically require a deeper runbook and a longer slot.

Two constraints from our side:
- The CISO (Ben) will be traveling Tue–Thu and prefers afternoons PT on Mon or Fri.
- Procurement needs at least a 90–120 minute window to cover contract/retention questions.

Can we reframe the demo from a 45-minute overview to a 2-hour technical + procurement block? We're flexible on format (split into an ops/security deep-dive + a short exec summary) but need the longer contiguous slot.

I've attached our initial security questionnaire so your team can see the areas they'll focus on. If you can propose two alternative windows I can run them quickly with my stakeholders.

Best,
Alice
Alice Morgan
Head of IT Programs
Treadstone Health
Attachment: treadstone-security-questions.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@treadstonehealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-04-11T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo — additional stakeholders and timing constraints

Hi Alice — thanks for the heads up and for sending the questionnaire.

Totally understand the need to expand the agenda. We can absolutely run a 2-hour block and split it into a 75–90 minute technical walk-through (ops, infra, security) followed by a 30–45 minute procurement + commercial Q&A. To make scheduling easier I ran this with a couple of internal folks and here are two slots that should work for the team on our side:

Option A: Monday, April 16 — 1:00pm–3:00pm PT
Option B: Friday, April 20 — 11:00am–1:00pm PT

If neither works for Ben's travel window we can propose one afternoon on Monday (4/16) or push to the following week.

I've CC'd Vivek (platform/infrastructure) and Karthik (procurement lead) so they can confirm availability and if they'd like any pre-read or add topics to the agenda.

I'll also attach an updated agenda (v2) with proposed time splits so procurement knows where to slot their questions.

Thanks — Chloe
Chloe Martin
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
chloe_martin@redwood.ai
Attachment: redwood-demo-agenda-v2.pdf (PDF)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: chloe_martin@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@treadstonehealth.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-04-11T13:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo — additional stakeholders and timing constraints

Chloe / team — quick note from infra side.

Thanks for routing the questionnaire, Alice — useful callouts. From our calendar: we can cover either of Chloe's proposed windows, but a couple of asks to make the 2-hour block high bandwidth:

- Can Treadstone share a brief list of the security owners + titles so we can tailor the runbook (networking, kms, logging, data flow)?
- We'll prepare a focused KV-cache/latency section — that will take ~25 minutes including Q&A.
- For procurement: Karthik, happy to sit in for contract-related items; would you like a separate breakout after the main demo?

If the CISO is only available Monday afternoon, Option A (Mon 4/16 1–3pm PT) is our preferred pick. If that gets tight we can also do Friday mid-day.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Platform & Infra, Redwood Inference
Attachment: (none)

Date: 2028-04-12T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo — additional stakeholders and timing constraints

Chloe — Monday 4/16 1:00pm–3:00pm PT works for our group (Ben will be back in town that morning). Appreciate the flexibility.

Next steps:
- Please send a calendar invite to all attendees for Mon 4/16 1–3pm PT.
- We'll add two procurement contacts once I get sign-off (I'll forward their emails).
- We're attaching the procurement intake doc to the invite; feel free to add any items you want covered in that breakout.

Looking forward to the run-through — we'll be joined by: Ben Chu (CISO), Priya Rao (Senior Procurement Manager), and Amal Desai (Contracts).

Thanks — Alice
Alice Morgan
Head of IT Programs, Treadstone Health
Attachment: procurement-intake-template.docx (doc)
